title: Reinforcement Guided Multi-Task Learning Framework for Low-Resource Stereotype Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Creating a fine-grained evaluation dataset differentiating explicit stereotypes, implicit stereotypical associations, and non-stereotypes using Reddit data, StereoSet, and CrowS-Pairs, and evaluating the detection performance of a reinforcement-learning guided multi-task framework.
Evaluating the multi-task learning framework's classification performance on a Misogyny Detection dataset to improve target task learning.
Evaluating the classification performance of the multi-task learning framework on a Hate Speech Detection dataset sourced from a white-supremacist forum (Stormfront).
